title: Australia Patch 4 is available
officialSummary: Australia Patch 4 was released on 9 July 2026 and was listed as available when this entry was verified.
editorialImplication: Teams running Australia should compare their current patch level and planned maintenance window against the newly available patch.
recommendedActions: Confirm the current patch level of each instance.
Review the Patch 4 problem-fix notes and security notes available to your organization.
Validate the target patch in non-production before scheduling production.

title: Flow Designer upgrade regressions are fixed
officialSummary: The July Australia-compatible release fixes Flow Designer data pills, a subflow test freeze involving dependent inputs, and removes JavaScript reference qualifiers for a security problem.
editorialImplication: The release is especially relevant to teams blocked by Australia upgrade regressions or maintaining flows that use dependent inputs.
recommendedActions: Identify affected flows and subflows in development.
Re-run automated and manual flow tests after updating.
Review custom reference qualifiers for assumptions affected by the security change.

title: UI Builder authoring defects are fixed
officialSummary: The July UI Builder release addresses several authoring defects, including repeated server-script execution, incomplete guided tours, Interaction Builder branching problems, and an inability to add the Calendar component.
editorialImplication: Teams experiencing unstable authoring or unexpected server work should prioritize a focused regression test of their most complex pages.
recommendedActions: Retest pages using server-script steps, custom dialogs, and Interaction Builder branches.
Verify Calendar component authoring where it was previously blocked.

title: Platform Analytics receives broad dashboard fixes
officialSummary: Version 8.4.1 fixes dashboard data being overwritten, date and timezone filtering errors, lost work notes during drilldown refreshes, permission errors, and several navigation and accessibility defects.
editorialImplication: This is a broad maintenance release for organizations relying on dashboards for operational decisions; date-sensitive and editable dashboards deserve regression coverage.
recommendedActions: Retest business-calendar, date-filtered, and multi-tab dashboards.
Validate drilldowns from Service Operations Workspace with unsaved work notes.
Confirm dashboard permissions with representative non-admin users.

title: Usage Insights can measure cross-application journeys
officialSummary: Usage Insights adds conversation analytics, cross-application conversion funnels, session- and user-based funnels, no-code event tracking, Platform Analytics integration, and accessibility improvements.
editorialImplication: Product teams can measure journeys that cross portals or workspaces without treating each application as an isolated experience.
recommendedActions: Choose one high-value cross-application journey for a funnel pilot.
Define the events and success outcome before enabling additional tracking.

title: ITSM changes its default AI model selection
officialSummary: ITSM skills and agents no longer default to Now LLM; each defaults to an optimized small third-party model, while large third-party models require approval.
editorialImplication: Model behavior, data-governance expectations, approvals, cost, and output quality may differ even when the user-facing skill appears unchanged.
recommendedActions: Inventory enabled ITSM skills and their configured models.
Confirm third-party model approval and governance requirements.
Benchmark output quality and latency with representative incidents before rollout.

title: Service Portal gains in-form ticket deflection
officialSummary: ITSM Foundation adds in-form ticket deflection in Service Portal, using AI to classify intent, retrieve knowledge, and suggest a resolution before submission.
editorialImplication: The capability could reduce avoidable demand, but only if suggestion quality and user escape paths are measured carefully.
recommendedActions: Pilot with a bounded request population.
Measure deflection, abandonment, reopen, and escalation rates.
Review knowledge coverage and feedback paths before wider adoption.

title: SOW related-list operations are fixed for Zurich
officialSummary: The July Zurich-compatible release fixes problems adding interactions to incidents and approvers to requested items through their related lists.
editorialImplication: Zurich customers using these related-list workflows can target a small but operationally visible defect fix without waiting for a family upgrade.
recommendedActions: Confirm the installed SOW ITSM Applications version.
Retest both related-list operations with fulfiller personas after updating.

source.title: Service Operations Workspace ITSM Applications release notes

title: CMDB MCP server moves to a separate application
officialSummary: The CMDB MCP server is removed from the Now Assist for CMDB plugin and its registry records are inactive; ServiceNow provides the CMDB MCP and Visibility Server as a separate application.
editorialImplication: Existing integrations that assume the MCP server is delivered by the Now Assist plugin need a dependency and installation review.
recommendedActions: Inventory CMDB MCP consumers and registry records.
Evaluate and approve the separate CMDB MCP and Visibility Server application.
Regression-test authentication, tools, and downstream agent workflows.

source.title: Now Assist for CMDB release notes

title: CMDB adds topology-aware impact analysis
officialSummary: Now Assist for CMDB adds topology-aware qualitative impact analysis for change and incident records associated with configuration items.
editorialImplication: This may improve triage and change assessment where CI relationships are trustworthy; weak topology data will limit its value.
recommendedActions: Pilot with services that have strong ownership and relationship quality.
Compare generated impact analysis with expert assessments.
Track incorrect or unsupported conclusions before broader use.

source.title: Now Assist for CMDB release notes

title: CMDB governance and remediation defects are fixed
officialSummary: CMDB Workspace fixes disabled editing for single-CI Data Manager tasks, inconsistent remediation access on de-duplication tasks, and missing location hierarchy information in Conditional Search.
editorialImplication: The update removes friction from common governance and remediation workflows rather than introducing new configuration.
recommendedActions: Retest single-CI review, de-duplication remediation, and location-based Conditional Search.
Confirm the fixes with the operational teams that reported the original symptoms.

title: Service Observability adds MetricBase data mappings
officialSummary: Service Observability can use MetricBase running on Agent Client Collector as a data source for data mappings; default dashboards still contain only CMDB-based data unless customized.
editorialImplication: Metric availability does not automatically produce useful visualizations, so adoption includes dashboard design and validation work.
recommendedActions: Confirm ACC and MetricBase prerequisites.
Prototype the required custom dashboard charts.
Validate metric freshness and mapping quality before operational use.

title: Strategic Planning expands portfolio controls
officialSummary: Strategic Planning adds backlog and hierarchy access for teams connected to Collaborative Work Management, dependency change views, spillover calculations, persistent hierarchy expansion, and on-demand regeneration for Portfolio AI Insights.
editorialImplication: The release can reduce planning friction, but changes to calculations and AI refresh behavior should be reconciled with portfolio operating practices.
recommendedActions: Select one portfolio to test spillover calculations and dependency views.
Document when Portfolio AI Insights should be regenerated and by whom.
Validate permissions for connected CWM teams.

title: Project Workspace redesigns RIDAC navigation
officialSummary: Project Workspace replaces the flat RIDAC grid with dedicated AI-identified risk, type-specific, and all-RIDAC views.
editorialImplication: The redesigned navigation may improve risk review but changes familiar operating procedures and training material.
recommendedActions: Walk project managers through the three new RIDAC views.
Update screenshots and instructions that reference the flat grid.
Confirm saved working practices remain possible.

title: Goal Framework adds status rollups
officialSummary: Goal Framework for SPM adds status rollup from target breakdowns to cumulative targets and from targets to goals.
editorialImplication: Automated rollups can reduce manual status work, but calculation and exception rules need to match the organization's goal-governance model.
recommendedActions: Model a representative cumulative target hierarchy in sub-production.
Reconcile rolled-up status with the existing executive reporting method.

source.title: Goal Framework for SPM release notes

title: Australia Patch 5 becomes available
officialSummary: Australia Patch 5 was released on 7 August 2026 and was listed as available when this entry was verified.
editorialImplication: Australia customers gained a newer maintenance target and should reassess any plan that still points to Patch 4.
recommendedActions: Confirm the current patch level and maintenance target for every Australia instance.
Review the Patch 5 problem-fix notes and restricted security notes available to your organization.
Validate Patch 5 in non-production before changing the production schedule.

title: Build Agent adds selectable models, skills, safer scripts, and broader MCP support
officialSummary: Build Agent Trial 2.5.6 adds model selection, custom skills and rules, contained background-script execution, Developer Sandbox support, ATF synchronization, and additional MCP integrations.
editorialImplication: The release expands both the power and governance surface of AI-assisted development, especially where external MCP servers or executable scripts are enabled.
recommendedActions: Define which model providers and MCP servers developers may use.
Test dry-run, rollback, and scope restrictions for generated background scripts.
Pilot ATF synchronization in an isolated application before wider adoption.

title: ServiceNow Studio exposes Fluent source and expands Git operations
officialSummary: ServiceNow IDE 4.4.4 lets developers use IDE capabilities inside ServiceNow Studio, open Fluent files from a new Explorer tab, inspect underlying Fluent source, and use a newer source-control integration with additional Git commands.
editorialImplication: Teams can consolidate more source-oriented work in Studio, but should align repository practices and training before changing their standard development path.
recommendedActions: Pilot Fluent source inspection with a representative scoped application.
Document the approved Git workflow and commands for Studio users.
Compare the new experience with existing IDE and CI practices before standardizing.

title: ITSM ticket creation gains context-aware suggestions
officialSummary: ITSM Foundation 2.3.3 can show employees an AI-generated suggestion before Service Portal ticket submission using the description plus relevant knowledge, catalog, hardware, location, and department context.
editorialImplication: The capability may reduce avoidable tickets, but it also broadens the context used for recommendations and requires outcome and relevance measurement.
recommendedActions: Confirm which contextual data is used and appropriate for the target population.
Pilot with a bounded request category and representative knowledge coverage.
Measure suggestion acceptance, abandonment, escalation, and reopen rates.

title: ITSM Foundation corrects multiple AI-agent and dashboard failures
officialSummary: Version 2.3.3 fixes irrelevant request summaries, incident-clustering failures, unavailable investigation services, unapplied knowledge filters, unintentionally discoverable built-in agents, a missing Link Major Incident role, and incorrect CI assignment by the triage agent.
editorialImplication: Organizations using these AI capabilities have several concrete regression candidates and may be able to close known operational defects with one application update.
recommendedActions: Map the documented fixes to open incidents and known workarounds.
Regression-test clustering, investigation, knowledge filtering, agent visibility, and CI assignment.
Remove obsolete workarounds only after validation in non-production.

title: Order-guide requests move to a unified parent-request experience
officialSummary: Simplified ITSM 3.2.3 presents the parent Request as the primary entity for order-guide confirmations, My Requests, filtering, approvals, and notifications, and adds initial support for the same simplified request experience in Employee Slate.
editorialImplication: Request visibility and communications can shift from individual requested items to the parent request, affecting user guidance, approval expectations, and custom notification logic.
recommendedActions: Test representative multi-item order guides from submission through approval and completion.
Review custom notifications and portal components that assume RITM-level presentation.
Update requester guidance before enabling the simplified experience broadly.

source.title: Simplified IT Service Management release notes

title: CMDB Workspace changes dependency-map behavior for service instances
officialSummary: CMDB Workspace 9.3.0 shows dependency maps in Unified Map for specific Service Instance CI classes instead of service maps, adds 400% browser zoom support, and includes Data Manager, Data Certification, CI form, and internationalization fixes.
editorialImplication: The map shown for affected service-instance classes can differ after updating, so operational procedures and custom extensions around topology navigation deserve review.
recommendedActions: Identify Service Instance classes and workflows that open maps from CMDB Workspace.
Compare Unified Map output with the prior service-map experience.
Regression-test Data Manager, certification, CI forms, and accessibility at high zoom.

title: CMDB success advisor expands dashboard summarization
officialSummary: ServiceNow Otto for CMDB 4.2.0 adds CMDB success-advisor summarization to the Hardware Asset Management and Data Foundations dashboards and includes security fixes.
editorialImplication: The new summaries may accelerate review, but their usefulness depends on dashboard data quality and should not replace validation of underlying findings.
recommendedActions: Pilot both dashboard summaries with accountable CMDB and HAM owners.
Compare recommended actions with the underlying dashboard evidence.
Record misleading or unsupported recommendations before wider use.

source.title: ServiceNow Otto for CMDB release notes

title: Strategic Planning brings RIDAC directly into planning work
officialSummary: Strategic Planning 4.17.0 adds RIDAC related lists and configurable record-page views for planning items, EAP iterations, and goals, plus an L2 RIDAC menu covering project, portfolio, and program risks with role-based access.
editorialImplication: Governance records can be managed closer to planning work, but permissions and ownership should be reconciled with existing RIDAC processes before adoption.
recommendedActions: Map current RIDAC roles and handoffs to the new access model.
Pilot the related lists and L2 menu with one portfolio.
Confirm read-only fields and edit rights match governance policy.

title: Project Workspace connects CWM work and preserves personalized navigation
officialSummary: Project Workspace 7.5.0 adds persistent L2 menu personalization, optional hiding of the legacy RIDAC page, inline display of connected Collaborative Work Management tasks and stories, and a setting to show or hide those connected tasks.
editorialImplication: The workspace can consolidate project and team execution views, but navigation choices, permissions, and the read-only inline task behavior need clear operating guidance.
recommendedActions: Pilot connected CWM tasks with a project team that uses both applications.
Decide whether to hide the legacy RIDAC page and document the target navigation.
Validate permissions and form-based editing for connected child work.

title: Usage Insights adds prior-period funnel comparisons
officialSummary: Usage Insights 6.3.10 adds previous-period comparison for conversion funnels, including deltas for completion, step conversion, and transition timing plus a step-comparison table.
editorialImplication: Teams can move from point-in-time adoption snapshots to trend analysis, provided event definitions and comparison periods remain stable.
recommendedActions: Select a mature funnel with stable event definitions for the first comparison.
Document the comparison period and any product changes that affect interpretation.
Use deltas to form a testable adoption hypothesis rather than treating correlation as causation.

title: Data Catalog adds bulk glossary and cloud metadata collection
officialSummary: The September Data Catalog release adds XLSX bulk import and export for glossary terms, cloud metadata collectors that do not require a hosted MID Server, rich-text asset documentation, SAP HANA and Salesforce collectors, and progressive lineage loading.
editorialImplication: The release can lower catalog onboarding effort, but bulk governance, connector authorization, and lineage completeness need explicit controls.
recommendedActions: Pilot glossary import with validation and rollback criteria.
Review cloud-collector credentials, network paths, and data-access boundaries.
Measure lineage completeness and load behavior on a representative large data domain.

title: Impact retires legacy accelerators and Health Diagnostics artifacts
officialSummary: Impact 11.0.0 removes five named legacy technical Accelerators and removes Impact Proactive Code Check or Health Diagnostics UI artifacts, navigation entries, and background jobs.
editorialImplication: Teams relying on retired accelerators, diagnostics navigation, or diagnostics-specific tables need to identify a supported replacement before updating.
recommendedActions: Inventory use of the retired accelerators and Health Diagnostics artifacts.
Search customizations and reports for diagnostics-specific tables or navigation links.
Agree replacement guidance and remove dependencies before the application update.

title: Virtual Agent for NLU and keywords enters future-deprecation planning
officialSummary: Starting with Brazil, Virtual Agent for NLU and Virtual Agent Lite are being prepared for future deprecation; the documented direction is to migrate to enhanced or premium chat and AI agents.
editorialImplication: Existing topic design, NLU models, integrations, and reporting should be treated as migration inventory even though the capabilities remain supported for now.
recommendedActions: Inventory production assistants that depend on NLU, keywords, or Virtual Agent Lite.
Map each use case to enhanced chat, premium chat, or AI-agent options.
Plan a measured migration with conversation-quality and containment benchmarks.

source.title: ServiceNow Otto for Virtual Agent release notes

title: AI Search removes two legacy profile-dashboard visualizations
officialSummary: Advanced AI Search Management Tools 9.0 removes the Searchable Documents and Documents by Search Source visualizations because their scheduled jobs and legacy dashboard tables are no longer available.
editorialImplication: Search administrators may lose familiar monitoring views and any derivative reporting that depends on the retired tables.
recommendedActions: Identify reports, jobs, or operating procedures that reference the two visualizations.
Confirm the supported replacement metrics before updating.
Preserve required baseline measurements for before-and-after comparison.

source.title: Advanced AI Search Management Tools release notes

title: ACC Visibility expands software discovery and inventory controls
application: Agent Client Collector for Visibility Content
officialSummary: ACC Visibility 2.0.3 adds package-manager software discovery, custom software filter rules, license-key discovery with parser scripts, and business-relevant software categorization.
editorialImplication: The release can improve inventory coverage, but custom filters and parsers can also hide or misclassify evidence if they are not governed and tested.
recommendedActions: Pilot package discovery on representative Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints.
Define review and test standards for custom filter and parser scripts.
Compare newly discovered software with the existing SAM inventory before automating decisions.

title: SOW deprecates its migration utility and flags two investigation adapters
officialSummary: Service Operations Workspace 9.5 deprecates Migration Utility for SOW with no replacement and prepares Agent Client Collector for Investigation and Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager for Investigation for future deprecation, also with no replacement documented.
editorialImplication: Customers using these plugins need explicit ownership and transition decisions because the notes do not identify replacement applications.
recommendedActions: Confirm whether each of the three plugins is installed, active, or referenced.
Document the business process and integrations supported by each plugin.
Raise replacement and timeline questions before the Brazil production plan is finalized.

source.title: Service Operations Workspace for ITSM release notes

title: SOW 9.5 adds entitlement-aware installation and attached knowledge by default
officialSummary: SOW 9.5 adds a scheduled batch installation for entitled SOW applications on newly provisioned zboot instances and shows Attached knowledge in Related records by default when an incident has an attached article.
editorialImplication: New-instance baselines and agent page behavior can change without the same manual installation and configuration sequence used previously.
recommendedActions: Validate the scheduled installation outcome on a representative newly provisioned instance.
Review entitlement and dependency expectations for automatically installed SOW applications.
Regression-test incident layouts and agent workflows with attached knowledge.

source.title: Service Operations Workspace for ITSM release notes

title: Project Workspace centralizes lists and adds direct cost recalculation
officialSummary: Project Workspace 7.6.2 adds a centralized Lists view with custom saved lists, direct recalculation of cost and benefit plans from Financials, dynamic document templates, and additional export, diagnostics, and template actions.
editorialImplication: Project teams can consolidate navigation and financial maintenance, but list ownership, recalculation authority, and document-template governance need definition.
recommendedActions: Pilot custom lists with project managers and define shared-list conventions.
Restrict and test cost recalculation with representative labor and budget-rate changes.
Review dynamic document templates and export controls before rollout.

title: Strategic Planning automates target status and expands program governance
officialSummary: Strategic Planning 4.18.0 adds portfolio RIDAC pages, automatically created program planning views, configurable automatic target-status calculation, scenario-approval notifications, Scrum configuration, and team-specific iteration cadence options.
editorialImplication: Several planning calculations and governance paths become more automated, making thresholds, access, fiscal-calendar behavior, and exception handling important adoption decisions.
recommendedActions: Validate default target-status thresholds against the existing governance model.
Review program-plan access and automatic backfill behavior with portfolio owners.
Pilot team-specific cadence and Scrum configuration without changing established teams first.

title: AI Admin Center simplifies opportunity analysis and removes legacy recommendation options
officialSummary: AI Admin Center 6.0 adds quick filters and matched-agent details for automation opportunities, allows deletion of custom analyses, limits custom data sets to one savings-profile formula, and removes the daily recommendation view.
editorialImplication: Existing opportunity-analysis practices may need adjustment where teams depend on multiple savings projections or daily recommendations.
recommendedActions: Inventory custom data sets with multiple savings projections.
Select the single formula that should remain authoritative and document its assumptions.
Update operating procedures that rely on daily recommendations.

title: Configurable Workspace expands AI-aware list and form customization
officialSummary: The Brazil Configurable Workspace release adds AI gradients for declarative actions, dynamic-schema form fields, semantic search for form templates, list-row context actions, AI grouping and summaries, configurable AI indicators, and Predicate Builder enhancements.
editorialImplication: The release broadens page-level design choices and AI cues, so design-system consistency, permissions, and generated grouping quality need review.
recommendedActions: Inventory custom declarative actions, form templates, and predicate-builder configurations.
Define accessibility and visual standards for AI gradients and indicators.
Test semantic search and AI grouping with representative records and edge cases.

title: Build Agent introduces spec-driven parallel implementation
officialSummary: Autonomous Engineer can turn requirements into an implementation plan with Agile-style work items, run parallel background agents to build them, generate and execute ATF tests, surface items needing human intervention, and produce an update set for deployment.
editorialImplication: This changes application delivery from conversational assistance to coordinated autonomous execution, increasing the need for bounded scope, review gates, and artifact-level accountability.
recommendedActions: Choose a low-risk scoped application for the first proof of concept.
Require human approval of requirements, plans, generated tests, and update-set contents.
Measure rework, test coverage, policy violations, and deployment defects against the existing process.

source.title: Build Agent and Autonomous Engineer release notes
